messages.subject: Shinyapps.io: Worker-Connection ID available?
parts:
I want to build an app that will be hosted on shinyapps.io that writes to an external database. Since there could be multiple instances containing multiple workers which have multiple connections, creating a unique record ID to write to the database is a challenge.


The main part of the challenge is an environment variable that increments with each write request could theoretically be duplicated in a simultaneously running instance / worker / connection.


One way to do it would be to have access to the unique connection ID, if there is such a thing.


I realise that some database implementations can force a unique ID, but for various reasons I want to be able to keep ID generation within the app. Clearly system time, user ID and an incremented variable could provide a solution that will *almost* always provide a unique combination, but to be absolutely watertight, a reference to the worker-connection instance would be necessary. Is this something a shiny app hosted in shinyapps.io can access?


Or is there a way that anybody can think of to generate guaranteed unique IDs between two simultaneous R processes where the user and time stamp could, theoretically, be identical.
